约定字符与字节的对应规则，使两端正确解释同一段文本。: Defines character/byte mappings so both peers interpret the same text correctly.
字符“网”的Unicode码点为U+7F51。字符、码点和用户看到的字形并非在所: The example character has Unicode code point U+7F51. Characters, code points and visible glyphs do not always map one-to-one.
U+7F51按UTF-8编码成E7 BD 91，共3字节；UTF-8对不同码点使: UTF-8 encodes U+7F51 as E7 BD 91, three bytes. UTF-8 uses one to four bytes depending on the code point.
HTTP等协议可以传这些字节。传输层只处理数据，不会自行猜出正确字符编码。: Protocols such as HTTP carry these bytes. Transport handles data without guessing the correct character encoding.
④ 用相同规则解码: ④ Decode using the same rules
接收端按UTF-8解释字节恢复字符。用不一致编码解读可能乱码，收到正确的TCP字: The receiver decodes UTF-8 to recover the character. A different encoding may produce garbled text; correct TCP bytes cannot repair an encoding mismatch.
UTF-8是字符编码标准，不是传输协议。字节长度与字符串字符数不同；内容长度等字: UTF-8 is a character encoding, not a transport protocol. Byte length differs from character count; length fields must follow protocol rules.
序列化结构化数据；字段含义与验证规则仍由应用约定。: Serializes structured data; the application still defines meanings and validation rules.
把对象结构表示成JSON文本，如{\"id\":7,\"ok\":true}。J: Represent objects as JSON text, for example {"id":7,"ok":true}. JSON supports objects, arrays, strings, numbers, booleans and null.
跨系统交换JSON文本通常用UTF-8。格式正确不表示数字范围、日期格式和字段含: Cross-system JSON commonly uses UTF-8. Valid syntax does not establish agreement on number ranges, date formats or field meanings.
放进HTTP响应体或WebSocket消息。直接用TCP时仍需要长度等应用定界，: Place JSON in an HTTP body or WebSocket message. Direct TCP still needs application framing; JSON does not add TCP message boundaries.
接收端先解析语法，再校验字段类型、必需字段和业务规则；反序列化不应意味着无条件信: Parse syntax, then validate types, required fields and business rules. Deserialization does not imply trusting input unconditionally.
JSON可作消息载荷: JSON can be a message payload
RPC系统可采用JSON序列化: RPC systems may serialize with JSON
JSON是数据格式，TLS是安全协议，HTTP是应用通信协议，三者负责不同问题。: JSON is a format, TLS a security protocol, and HTTP an application protocol. JSON has no native date type and cannot losslessly represent every language-specific object feature.
RPC · 一次远程调用怎样关联响应: RPC · Match a remote call to its response
把本地调用转换成请求，并处理参数、关联标识、结果与失败。: Turns calls into requests and handles parameters, correlation, results and failures.
调用代理将方法与参数编码，并生成请求关联ID。具体格式取决于RPC体系，图示不限: A proxy encodes the method and parameters and generates a correlation ID. Format depends on the RPC system; this diagram is not limited to ONC RPC or gRPC.
请求通过相应应用协议和底层传输交付。并发调用需要区分各自响应，关联ID不等同于T: An application protocol and transport deliver the request. Concurrent calls need distinct response correlation; request IDs are not TCP sequence numbers.
服务端解码参数、选择方法并执行业务。如果执行成功后响应丢失，客户端仍可能看到超时: The server decodes parameters, selects a method and executes it. If execution succeeds but the response is lost, the client may still time out.
返回关联ID与结果/错误，客户端恢复调用结果。超时后重试必须结合幂等性、去重或状: Return the ID and result/error. Retry after timeout requires idempotency, deduplication or a status query.
部分RPC体系直接基于TCP: Some RPC systems use TCP directly
RPC是协议族与调用模式；ONC RPC、JSON-RPC、gRPC的格式和承载: RPC is a family and invocation model; ONC RPC, JSON-RPC and gRPC differ in format and transport. Reliable transport does not guarantee exactly-once business execution.
这里用来说明OSI会话相关功能；实际TCP/IP中通常归入应用层。: Illustrates OSI session-related functions; normally application-layer in TCP/IP.
应用会话 · 多次请求怎样识别同一个用户: Sessions · Recognize one user across requests
在多个请求之间关联身份和交互状态，并管理过期与恢复。: Associates identity and interaction state across requests and manages expiration and recovery.
通过受保护的连接提交身份凭证，服务器验证用户。登录过程与TCP三次握手是不同层次: Submit credentials over a protected connection for verification. Login and the TCP handshake operate at different levels.
示例采用服务器端会话与Cookie标识。会话标识需不可预测，并根据场景设置Sec: This example uses server-side sessions and a cookie identifier. IDs must be unpredictable; configure Secure, HttpOnly and SameSite as appropriate.
③ 后续请求携带标识: ③ Include identifier in later requests
请求携带Cookie，服务器将标识关联到会话状态。即使换了TCP连接，仍可识别这: A cookie links the request to session state, even when the TCP connection changes.
服务器检查会话有效期和权限，注销或过期后使其失效。检查点和断点恢复还需要额外的应: The server checks expiration and permissions, invalidating sessions on logout or expiry. Checkpoints and resumption require additional design.
任务与调用也需要状态关联: Tasks and calls also need state correlation
OSI会话层、网站登录Session、TCP连接不是同一概念。示例是服务器端会话: OSI sessions, website sessions and TCP connections are distinct. This server-side example differs from stateless tokens in validation and invalidation.
应用会话管理是一类机制，不是名为SESSION的统一网络协议。: Session management is a class of mechanisms, not a universal protocol named SESSION.
提供有序字节流，通过序号、确认和重传恢复丢失。: Provides an ordered byte stream using sequencing, acknowledgment and retransmission.
假定连接已建立，发送1001～1500的连续字节。TCP序列号按字节计数，不是简: Assume an established connection sending bytes 1001–1500. TCP sequence numbers count bytes, not packets.
接收端累计确认到1500，下一期待字节为1501。ACK标志位与确认号字段是不同: The receiver cumulatively acknowledges through 1500 and expects 1501. The ACK flag and acknowledgment-number field are distinct.
发送1501～2000时发生丢失。图示消息带丢失标记，接收端未得到它，不应把箭头: Bytes 1501–2000 are lost. The loss marker means the receiver did not get them; the arrow does not indicate successful delivery.
发送端依据重传超时或其他丢失检测机制恢复丢失数据。图中简化为重传该连续范围，实际: The sender detects loss by timeout or another mechanism. The diagram retransmits one contiguous range; real segmentation and recovery may differ.
接收端补齐连续字节后推进累计确认，再按顺序交给应用。SYN、FIN各占一个序号，: Filling the gap advances cumulative acknowledgment and permits ordered application delivery. SYN and FIN consume sequence numbers; ordinary pure ACK does not.
HTTP/1.1、2常使用TCP: HTTP/1.1 and HTTP/2 often use TCP
安全保护由TLS等提供: TLS and related mechanisms provide security
发送约束由接收窗口rwnd、拥塞窗口cwnd及在途数据共同决定。TCP不保留应用: rwnd, cwnd and in-flight data constrain sending. TCP has no application message boundaries, so applications need framing. Irrecoverable failures can still reach the application.
该图侧重已建连后的丢失恢复；握手与关闭可在TCP/UDP实验中查看。: Focuses on recovery after establishment. See transport labs for handshakes and closing.
UDP · 消息边界保留，送达不保证: UDP · Boundaries preserved, delivery not guaranteed
用端口区分进程，以数据报形式提交独立消息。: Uses ports to identify processes and submits independent datagrams.
每次提交形成独立UDP数据报；长度字段包括UDP头和数据，基本头8字节。: Each submission forms an independent UDP datagram. Length includes the 8-byte header and data.
IP路径可能丢失分组。UDP自身没有确认、超时补发或排序机制。: IP paths can lose packets. UDP supplies no acknowledgments, timeout retransmission or ordering itself.
数据报3可以正常到达，而2仍未送达；应用不能假定UDP会补齐中间数据。其他情况下: Datagram 3 can arrive while 2 remains missing. The application cannot expect UDP to fill gaps. Paths and queues may also reorder arrivals.
应用按需求处理缺失、丢弃过时数据或自行恢复。UDP校验和用于差错检测，不等于可靠: The application handles gaps, discards stale data or implements recovery. A UDP checksum detects errors but does not provide reliable delivery.
四个16位字段为源端口、目的端口、长度、校验和。IPv4中的UDP零校验和表示未: Four 16-bit fields: source port, destination port, length and checksum. IPv4 zero checksum means none was supplied. IPv6 normally requires a checksum, with limited tunnel exceptions.
图示是可能出现的丢失和乱序情形，不代表每次UDP通信都会丢包。: Illustrates possible loss and reordering, not inevitable loss in every UDP exchange.
QUIC · UDP上怎样实现可靠多流: QUIC · Reliable multiple streams over UDP
组合连接ID、多流、丢失恢复、拥塞控制和TLS 1.3安全握手。: Combines connection IDs, streams, recovery, congestion control and TLS 1.3 handshakes.
QUIC通过UDP报文承载初始QUIC包和TLS握手数据。QUIC包号与流偏移分: UDP carries initial QUIC packets and TLS handshake data. Packet numbers support recovery; stream offsets support data reassembly.
服务器回应并提供TLS握手信息；双方建立应用数据密钥。QUIC整合TLS握手，不: The server responds with TLS handshake information; peers establish application keys. QUIC integrates TLS handshakes, not traditional TLS records inside UDP.
同一连接内多个流独立交付有序字节，避免一个流缺失字节必然阻塞所有其他流。流内仍可: Streams independently deliver ordered bytes. A gap in one stream need not block every other stream, although that stream may wait for its missing bytes.
QUIC确认收到的包范围，依据丢失检测重新发送需要的数据，新的发送使用新的包号。: QUIC acknowledges packet ranges and resends needed data based on loss detection, using new packet numbers.
在具备条件时，连接ID和路径验证帮助在地址变化后维持连接。拥塞与流控仍必不可少。: Under suitable conditions, connection IDs and path validation preserve a connection after address changes. Congestion and flow control remain necessary.
QUIC可靠性来自自己的恢复机制，而不是UDP。跨流交付减少传输层跨流队头阻塞，: QUIC reliability comes from its own recovery, not UDP. Independent streams reduce cross-stream transport blocking, not within-stream ordering or all application dependencies.
按目的地址和最长前缀匹配选下一跳，提供尽力而为转发。: Selects next hops by destination and longest-prefix match, providing best-effort forwarding.
用目的地址与本地前缀判断是否在本地。跨网段时查路由选择网关，再解析下一跳MAC；: Compare destination and local prefix. For remote traffic, select a gateway and resolve its MAC, not the remote host MAC.
② 帧交给下一跳: ② Deliver frame to next hop
源/目的IP为A/B，链路目的MAC为当前网关。以太网帧负责这一跳，IP地址用于: IP endpoints remain A/B; this frame targets the gateway MAC. Ethernet handles one hop, IP addressing spans networks.
路由器移除当前链路封装，查找路由并减少TTL，更新IPv4头校验和。TTL耗尽时: The router removes link encapsulation, looks up a route, decrements TTL and updates the IPv4 checksum. Exhausted TTL stops forwarding.
新链路使用新的源/目的MAC，普通无NAT转发中源/目的IP不变。需要时按MTU: New link MAC addresses are used while IP addresses remain unchanged without NAT. MTU and DF rules govern fragmentation or errors when needed.
目的端根据IP协议号把载荷交给TCP、UDP、ICMP等；若存在分片，先按规则重: The destination uses the protocol number to deliver to TCP, UDP or ICMP. Fragments are reassembled first where applicable.
IPv4地址32位，基本头20字节。最长前缀匹配优先选择更具体路由；缺省路由只在: IPv4 has 32-bit addresses and a 20-byte base header. More-specific routes take precedence; defaults apply without a better match. NAT changes addresses and needs separate analysis.
图示无NAT，忽略额外隧道封装与策略路由。: No NAT; additional tunnels and policy routing are omitted.
IPv6 · 转发与分片怎样改变: IPv6 · Changes in forwarding and fragmentation
128位寻址，固定40字节基本头，依靠扩展头表达附加功能。: 128-bit addressing, fixed 40-byte base header and extension headers for additional functions.
按路由表选下一跳，用NDP解析链路地址；IPv6不使用IPv4的ARP。: Select a next hop and resolve its link address with NDP. IPv6 does not use IPv4 ARP.
基本头包含源/目的地址、Next Header与Hop Limit等，不含IPv: The base header includes addresses, Next Header and Hop Limit, without an IPv4-style header checksum.
③ 转发或Packet Too Big: ③ Forward or Packet Too Big
路由器减少Hop Limit。如果分组超过出链路MTU，路由器不分片，而可通过I: The router decrements Hop Limit. An oversized packet is not fragmented by the router; ICMPv6 can report Packet Too Big.
④ 逐跳到达目的端: ④ Reach destination hop by hop
符合MTU的分组继续转发。源端根据反馈减小发送大小，必要时由源端用分片扩展头分片: Packets within MTU continue. The source reduces size from feedback or uses a Fragment extension header if needed.
可靠传输与IP版本独立: Reliable transport is independent of IP version
Next Header可以指向扩展头或上层协议，不能总当成直接的TCP/UDP标: Next Header may identify an extension header rather than directly TCP/UDP. IPv6 has unicast, multicast and anycast but no broadcast. A larger address space does not imply security.
第三步描述分支，过大的分组不会同时被继续转发。: Step three is a branch; oversized packets are not also forwarded onward.
ICMP · ping与路由超时反馈: ICMP · ping and routing timeout feedback
反馈部分网络差错，并提供回显等诊断消息。: Reports some network errors and provides echo diagnostics.
ping常发送ICMP Echo Request；traceroute探测也可以: ping commonly sends ICMP Echo Request. traceroute may use UDP, TCP or other probes with increasing TTL.
目标可回答回显；路由器发现TTL耗尽、目标不可达等情形时，可按协议和策略生成相应: A target can echo; routers may report expired TTL or unreachable destinations according to protocol and policy.
回显应答表示相应探测得到了回应；Time Exceeded等可帮助分析路径，差错: Echo replies confirm a probe response. Time Exceeded helps inspect paths; errors often quote the original packet.
工具关联探测与反馈，计算时间或记录节点。没有回应也可能是策略过滤或限速，不能单独: Tools correlate feedback, calculate time or record nodes. Silence may reflect filtering or rate limits, not necessarily an offline host.
ping不测试TCP服务可用: ping does not test TCP service availability
ICMP使用类型、代码和校验和，没有TCP/UDP端口。它提供差错反馈而非给IP: ICMP uses type, code and checksum, without TCP/UDP ports. It supplies feedback rather than reliable retransmission; combine diagnostics with real service connections.
OSPF · 拓扑怎样变成路由表: OSPF · From topology to routing table
在自治系统内部交换链路状态，再运行最短路径计算。: Exchanges link state within an autonomous system and computes shortest paths.
交换Hello检查关键参数，建立适用的邻居/邻接关系。并非每一对可见邻居都会按同: Hello checks parameters and establishes suitable neighbor/adjacency relationships. Visible neighbors do not all form full adjacencies identically.
通过数据库描述、请求和更新等报文同步LSA，使同一区域在收敛后具有一致的拓扑认识: Database descriptions, requests and updates synchronize LSAs, giving routers in one area a consistent topology after convergence.
链路变化触发相应状态信息传播。序列号、寿命与确认等机制帮助控制更新并保持数据库。: Link changes propagate state. Sequence numbers, ages and acknowledgments control updates and maintain databases.
④ SPF计算并生成路由: ④ Run SPF and derive routes
按链路代价运行最短路径计算，将符合规则的结果交给路由信息体系，数据转发再按已生成: Compute shortest paths using link costs and supply valid results to routing information. Forwarding then uses generated tables.
域间策略路由用途不同: Inter-domain policy routing has a different role
OSPF是控制平面，IP转发是数据平面。区域、骨干区域、DR/BDR及汇总等影响: OSPF is control plane; IP forwarding is data plane. Areas, backbone, DR/BDR and summarization organize larger networks; this diagram shows one-area basics.
图示聚合多台邻居，不逐个绘制全部LSA报文。: Neighbors are aggregated; individual LSA messages are omitted.
以组播与邻居报文完成链路地址解析，并支持路由器发现。: Uses multicast and neighbor messages for link-address resolution and router discovery.
① RS / RA发现路由器: ① Discover routers with RS / RA
主机可发Router Solicitation，路由器发Router Adver: Hosts may send Router Solicitation; routers advertise lifetimes, prefixes and parameters in RA, also periodically without solicitation.
需要解析链路地址时，向目标对应的请求节点组播地址发送Neighbor Solic: Send Neighbor Solicitation to the target solicited-node multicast address rather than an IPv4-style ARP broadcast.
③ NA报告链路地址: ③ Report link address with NA
目标通过Neighbor Advertisement提供信息；主机更新邻居缓存，: The target supplies Neighbor Advertisement. The host updates its cache and can deliver frames to the next hop.
邻居可达性检测维护状态。Packet Too Big等其他ICMPv6类型另行承: Neighbor reachability detection maintains state. Other ICMPv6 types, such as Packet Too Big, supply MTU feedback; NS/NA do not handle all diagnostics.
IPv4使用ARP，IPv6不用: IPv4 uses ARP; IPv6 does not
把邻居地址映射到链路地址: Maps neighbor addresses to link addresses
NDP不止“IPv6版ARP”，还承担路由器发现、重定向和可达性等功能。地址无状: NDP does more than replace ARP: router discovery, redirection and reachability also matter. Stateless autoconfiguration and duplicate detection use related mechanisms and SLAAC rules.
将邻居与路由器合并为一个参与者，仅表示职责，实际设备可以不同。: Neighbor and router are combined as one participant to show roles; real devices may differ.
IPsec · 原始IP包怎样穿过安全隧道: IPsec · Through a secure IP tunnel
通过安全关联保护IP数据，隧道模式在外层再加IP封装。: Security associations protect IP data; tunnel mode adds outer IP encapsulation.
常用IKE协商算法、密钥与参数。安全关联通常具有方向性，双向通信需要对应的保护状: IKE commonly negotiates algorithms, keys and parameters. Associations are normally directional; bidirectional traffic needs corresponding state.
在ESP隧道模式下，原始IP分组被作为内层数据保护；按协商算法进行加密、完整性与: ESP tunnel mode protects the original IP packet as inner data, using negotiated encryption, integrity and anti-replay processing.
外层源/目的地址指向隧道端点，公网路由器据此外层转发。加密载荷不妨碍它们读取外层: Outer addresses identify tunnel endpoints. Public routers forward using them even though the inner payload is encrypted.
